description: Record the proposed level of service for a LoS measure in one future year (O. Reg. 588/17 s. 6(1)). One row per measure and year; a duplicate returns 409, so update the existing row instead. Use target_statement for a community measure and target_value for a technical one. Requires los_proposed_targets:write scope. Resolve los_measure_id first via list_los_measures.

target_statement.description: Proposed level of service for a community measure, as a statement

target_value.description: Proposed value for a technical measure, in the measure's own unit

name: create_los_proposed_target
title: Create LoS proposed target
